title: Kanye West's Relationship With Julia Fox Is Calculated, She Might Know Something About Pete Davidson, Says Wack 100
htmlContent:
Kanye West currently sees actress Julia Fox after his divorce from Kim Kardashian. It was reported that they went on their first date over the new years holiday in Miami. However, according to E! News, a source close to West shared, it is not too serious.

 "expressed it's not serious" between him and Julia, adding, "He's not looking for anything right now and is really focused on his business."

Per E! News, Fox is also on the same page.

"She's having fun and taking it day by day, but being a mom to her son is her number one priority." Like West, she is also going through the divorce process with Peter Artemiev.

"Kanye and Julia hit it off from the very first interaction they had," the source close to Ye told E! News. "He truly loved her energy and passionate personality and knew she would be a perfect person to bounce creative ideas off of. He thinks she has refreshing energy and they are having a lot of fun. Kanye is always working on something creative and Julia is definitely his latest muse. He had a vision for her and that's what inspired their date. He was bouncing off all these plans for his ideas, and she happily gave in and obliged."

Wack 100 was on recently on Clubhouse in the EBAN FILMS room and asked about Kanye West and Julia Fox's relationship.

"Is he dating her? How long has she been around? Who is she tied to? Does she have any ties to anybody? You gotta do the math on that," said Wack 100.

"You have to research on her, though, is she tied to anybody? With the bro [Kanye West], you have to pay attention. Who is the n*** that Kim Kardashian is running around with?

The answer is Pete Davidson.

"Is she [Julia Fox] tied to him in any way? I just know bro, I know how he moves. If so, that tells me something," Wack told the room.

It turns out Fox and Davidson appeared as Barbie and Ken in a 2019 photoshoot for Paper magazine. However, according to Newsweek, the two were never romantically linked.

"There it goes," he shared. With saying that and knowing what's going on, I don't know if I take it seriously, my brother. Now, you would say Pete is already down with her."

They didn't date, "So there's a good chance she might know something," said Wack.

Per U.S. Sun insider, Kardashian thinks West and fox dating is a "desperate attempt to make her jealous."

"She knows it's not serious and is just typical hijinks from Kanye," the source added. "She honestly doesn't care, she's very over him at this point so his little game isn't working."
